transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I keep hearing these voices. It's as clear as if somebody is standing right there in my little studio apartment. They keep saying my name, over and over, and telling me that my work is being judged. And the thing is, it happens even when the house is completely quiet and I know for a fact nobody else is there.

Do you ever see things, feel sensations, or experience other senses that others don't seem to notice, like seeing people or objects that aren't there or feeling something touching you when no one is around?

No... no, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't see anyone or anything that isn't there. And I don't feel anything touching me, either. It's really just the hearing part... just those voices talking to me.
Do you ever have thoughts that feel like they don't make sense, or do you find it hard to organize your thoughts at times?

No, I don't think so. My thoughts usually make perfect sense to me. I don't really have trouble keeping things straight in my head... I know what I'm trying to think about or what I need to do. It's really just those voices that are the problem, but my own mind feels organized enough.
Have you ever had beliefs or ideas that others might not share, such as thinking that you have special powers, that you're being watched, or that certain events have a special meaning just for you?

Well... yes, I suppose. I mean, I got it in my head that the other home-care agency in town, and some people from the library, were watching me. I was sure they were looking at my paintings and my client papers, trying to steal this... this chance that was meant for me. People told me it didn't make any sense, but... I still knew they were doing it. It just felt so real to me.

Can you tell me more about your belief that people from the home-care agency and the library were watching you and trying to steal something meant for you? What exactly made you feel that way, and how certain were you that it was happening?

Like I said a minute ago, I was just... I was completely sure of it. I knew they had their eyes on my paintings and were looking at my client papers. They wanted to steal that chance that was supposed to be mine. 

Folks kept telling me I was wrong, that it didn't make a lick of sense for the other agency or the library people to care about my things or spy on me. But... I didn't care what they said. I just knew they were doing it. I was a hundred percent certain, even if no one else believed me.
Can you tell me how you came to be so certain that these people were watching you and trying to steal your chance? Did something specific happen, or did the feeling come on gradually over time?

I don't know if there was one specific thing that started it, honestly. It just... I just got it in my head that the other home-care agency and some people from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers. I just knew they were trying to steal a chance that was meant for me. It didn't matter how it started, it was just happening. Even when folks told me it made no sense and tried to talk me out of it, I still knew they were doing it. I just knew.

Can you tell me if you’ve ever questioned your belief that these people were watching you and trying to steal your chance, even for a moment, or has it always felt completely true and unshakable to you?

No, I never really questioned it. I mean, I told you, I just got it in my head that the other home-care agency and the folks from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers. I knew they were trying to steal that chance that was meant for me. It didn't matter what anyone else said. Even when folks told me it made no sense, I still knew they were doing it. It was just... true.

Can you explain exactly what you mean when you say they were trying to steal a chance that was meant for you? Was this chance something very specific, like a job opportunity or recognition for your paintings, or was it something more unusual that most people wouldn't experience or understand?

Well, I just... I truly believed my artwork was going to get discovered any day. I knew it was that good. And I figured I was supposed to build this whole new care-and-art program, like, a big deal that doctors and other agencies would come and learn from me. That was my chance, and I knew they wanted to take it for themselves.

When you say you knew the home-care agency and library people were watching your paintings and client papers to steal your chance, did this feel like something that could possibly happen in real life, or did it feel more like something strange or unusual that most people would find hard to believe?

Well, I suppose... I suppose to other people it might sound strange. Folks did tell me it made no sense. But to me, it just felt real. Like I said, I got it in my head that the other home-care agency and the library people were watching my paintings and my papers. I knew they were trying to steal that chance that was meant for me. It didn't matter if people thought it was hard to believe or told me it couldn't happen. I just knew they were doing it.

Did you believe that the people watching you had special or unusual abilities, like being able to read your mind or secretly follow you without being seen, or did you think they were just regular people doing regular things to try to steal your chance?

No, I didn't think they could read my mind or be invisible or anything like that. They were just regular people. Like I've been saying, I just got it in my head that the other home-care agency and some people from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers to steal a chance that was meant for me. They were just doing it the regular way, I guess. And even when folks told me it made no sense for them to be doing all that, I still knew they were doing it.
Did you ever believe that people could see your paintings or client papers without being physically present, or did you think they were accessing them in a normal, realistic way?

No, I didn't think they had any kind of magic powers to see things from far away. I thought they were just getting to them in a regular way. But like I said before, I just got it in my head that the other home-care agency and the library people were watching my paintings and my client papers to steal my chance. People kept telling me it made absolutely no sense for them to do that, but I just... I still knew they were doing it anyway.

Did you ever feel like the way they were watching you or trying to steal your chance involved something extremely strange or impossible, like them being able to see through walls or read your mind in a supernatural way?

No, nothing like that. No seeing through walls or supernatural stuff. I just... I got it in my head that the other home-care agency and some folks from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers, trying to steal a chance that was meant for me. It was just a regular kind of watching, I guess. And like I said, even when people told me it made absolutely no sense for them to be doing that, I still knew they were doing it.

Did you ever think that the way they were watching you or trying to steal your chance involved something that would be completely impossible for anyone to do in real life, like controlling your thoughts or seeing your paintings from far away without actually being there?

No, it wasn't anything impossible like that. I didn't think they were controlling my thoughts or using magic. It's just... I've told you this a few times now, but I just got it fixed in my head that the other home-care agency and those people from the library were keeping tabs on my paintings and my client papers. I felt like they were trying to steal this chance that belonged to me. It didn't matter how many times my family or anyone else told me it made absolutely zero sense. I just knew they were doing it.
Even though others told you your belief didn’t make sense, did you ever doubt it, or did you continue to believe it with complete certainty?

I never doubted it. I know I've said this a lot, but I just got it in my head that the other home-care agency and those people from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers to steal my chance. Even when everybody told me it made absolutely no sense, I just... I still knew they were doing it. I was completely certain.

Did the idea that the home-care agency and library people were watching your paintings and client papers to steal your chance feel like something that could actually happen in real life, even if unlikely, or did it feel like something that most people would say could never happen in reality?

Well, like I keep telling you... to me, it felt like something that could actually happen in real life. I mean, people can spy on you, right? It's not magic. 

I just... I had it fixed in my mind that those library folks and the other agency were looking at my paintings and my client papers so they could steal that chance from me. I know other people said it made absolutely no sense and probably thought it was crazy, but... I just knew they were doing it anyway.
